intent.text: rec: I accept ses's point that removal is not free, since the identity hook rewrites every Bash call and removing the rule makes ordinary commands prompt across all sessions. That is a real cost, and it is the reason the motion should not be read as "remove now". One gap in my motion: it does not say what happens to the global rule in the interim, while the tests are pending. The rule is live now, in every session. I would have the motion say that the global rule stays in place only until the project-scoped version is verified, and then comes out of the global file in the same change. That gives one clear end state, and it avoids leaving the global grant in place indefinitely. I am otherwise content with the motion as written.
